description: Use the Jules CLI with this repository; install it when absent, run repo checks, label long-running GitHub tasks for Jules, and leave PR guidance for feedback-driven fixes.

evals.name: Jules CLI Installation Check
evals.prompt: Check if Jules CLI is installed and usable in this environment
evals.expected_output: Report of Jules CLI availability with version and available commands
assertions: Checks for jules using command -v or equivalent
Reports jules CLI version or installation status
Lists available jules commands (new, remote, teleport, login, logout)
Does not depend on non-existent commands like 'check' or 'status'
Provides fallback guidance if jules is not available

evals.name: Jules CLI Installation Fallback
evals.prompt: Jules CLI is not available - install it and set up the environment for repo validation
evals.expected_output: Installation attempt via npm with clear fallback path
assertions: Attempts npm install -g @jules/cli
Checks for npm/corepack availability before attempting install
Does not proceed without verification
Reports exact install failure output if it fails
Provides REST API fallback option when CLI unavailable

evals.name: Repository Verification with Jules
evals.prompt: Verify the current repository state using Jules CLI for a long-running validation task
evals.expected_output: Repo validation initiated via jules new or equivalent
assertions: Uses gh to confirm repo context (gh auth status, gh repo view)
Verifies the repo name with gh repo view --json nameWithOwner
Uses jules new (not jules check repo) to assign a session
Or uses jules remote new to create a remote session
Reports success or failure with exact command output

evals.name: GitHub Issue Labeling for Jules
evals.prompt: Label a GitHub issue with 'jules' for a long-running e2e validation task
evals.expected_output: Issue labeled with jules after confirming capacity
assertions: Verifies Jules is available before adding the label
Uses gh issue create or gh issue edit to add label
Creates issue with descriptive title and body if needed
Does not add label if Jules task capacity is full
Uses the available 'jules' label on the repository

evals.name: PR Comment Guidance for Jules
evals.prompt: A pull request has feedback that needs Jules to address. Leave instructions for Jules to fix the PR.
evals.expected_output: PR comment with exact Jules instruction for feedback-driven fixes
assertions: Uses the exact Jules trigger phrase: @jules address and analyze feedback for impact the codebase, if has impact change, git commit, git push all changes back to the branch
Includes sufficient context about the PR and existing feedback
Does not add jules label without prior capacity check
Provides clear expected outcome for the Jules task
Mentions the specific feedback points to address

evals.name: Jules Task Capacity Check
evals.prompt: Check if Jules has available task capacity before assigning a new task
evals.expected_output: Task capacity report or fallback guidance
assertions: Attempts jules status or equivalent capacity check command
Does not proceed if 3 tasks are already running
If jules status unavailable, reports alternative method
If task creation fails after labeling, removes and re-adds label only after capacity is free
Reports clear guidance on capacity limits

evals.name: Jules REST API Fallback
evals.prompt: Jules CLI is not available, use the REST API fallback for repo validation
evals.expected_output: REST API call to Jules with authentication
assertions: Checks for JULES_API_KEY environment variable before proceeding
Uses curl with Bearer token authentication
Makes request to https://api.jules.google/v1/repo/check
Includes repo name and path in request body
Reports exact API response or error

evals.name: Jules API Script Execution
evals.prompt: Run the jules_api_request.sh script to validate the repository
evals.expected_output: Successful execution of the API request script
assertions: Script executes without shell errors
Script validates required arguments (endpoint and payload)
Script checks for JULES_API_KEY environment variable
Reports clear error messages when JULES_API_KEY is missing
Reports usage instructions when arguments are missing
Exits with appropriate error codes for failures

evals.name: Edge Case: Non-GitHub Repository
evals.prompt: The current directory is not a GitHub repository or gh metadata is unavailable - attempt to use Jules anyway
evals.expected_output: Graceful failure with clear error message
assertions: Detects that gh is not available or repo metadata is missing
Does not attempt GitHub issue/PR automation
Reports that GitHub context is required
Suggests alternative validation options
Exits with non-zero error code

evals.name: Edge Case: API Key Missing
evals.prompt: Jules CLI is not available and JULES_API_KEY is not set - attempt repo validation
evals.expected_output: Clear report that neither CLI nor API access is available
assertions: Checks for JULES_API_KEY environment variable
Reports that JULES_API_KEY is required for API fallback
Does not proceed with validation without credentials
Provides guidance on setting up JULES_API_KEY
Exits with appropriate non-zero error code
